name: Schneider Electric SE
monetization: Sells electrical distribution, secure power (APC UPS), cooling (Motivair), and EcoStruxure software into data centers — the group's largest growth driver at roughly a quarter of revenue.
description_md: Schneider Electric is the European heavyweight of energy management and industrial automation, and one of the two global leaders (with Vertiv/Eaton) in data-center electrical infrastructure. Its data-center offer spans medium/low-voltage distribution, switchgear, busway, Secure Power (the APC UPS franchise), prefabricated modular data centers, liquid cooling via Motivair, and the EcoStruxure software/DCIM stack. Data centers and networks account for roughly 24% of group revenue and are the group's biggest growth driver, with demand led by North American hyperscale and colocation customers.
ai_monetization_md: AI monetization is volume-driven: more megawatts of AI capacity means more switchgear, UPS, busway, cooling, and services. FY2025 revenue crossed the €40B mark for the first time (€40.2B, +8.9% organic) with Q4 2025 data-center orders growing at a triple-digit percentage y/y from hyperscale and colocation customers. Schneider also monetizes the design layer: it co-develops AI-ready reference architectures with NVIDIA and sells EcoStruxure software and services on top of the installed base, making part of the AI revenue recurring.
ai_strategy_md: Own the full electrical room and the software above it: pair the APC/Secure Power installed base with grid-side distribution, add liquid cooling through Motivair, and push prefabricated/modular builds that shorten hyperscaler deployment times. For 2026 the group targets 7–10% organic revenue growth and 10–15% organic adjusted EBITA growth, with data centers expected to remain the lead engine. Capacity expansion in North America — where lead times for electrical gear are a recognized industry bottleneck — is a stated priority.
risk_notes_md: Data-center concentration (~24% of revenue and rising) ties a historically diversified industrial to the AI capex cycle. Triple-digit order growth creates the same reversal risk seen across the cluster if hyperscaler capex pauses. Schneider announced a leadership change alongside its record FY2025 results; execution continuity is a watch item. Currency and the group's large China/industrial-automation exposure can mask or amplify the data-center story in reported numbers.

observations.notes: +8.9% organic; first year above €40B. Q4 2025 sales €11.1B, +10.7% organic, a quarterly record.
